blocks.text: Willoughby Elementary (20766 80 Ave) is an elementary school in Willoughby Heights. This is not a complete list of the schools nearby.

Willoughby Heights homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Willoughby Heights, September 2026. Detached houses: 100 listed at month end and 13 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 369 listed at month end and 70 sold in September, a sales ratio of 19% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 74 over 4 months against an average of 102.0 listed, about 5.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 26 sold. condos and townhomes sold 337 over 4 months against an average of 371.8 listed, about 4.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 103 sold.
